demos.heading: Try the Apps
demos.intro: Every card opens a live product. Where Authelia SSO is required, use the shared demo account (demo / DemoAccess2026!) — LLDAP group kecktech_demo, one-factor only, no admin/LLDAP/Traefik. Apps with their own login still show app-native demo credentials on the card.
